rights_note: 결과 그림은 토큰전쟁 마스코트 기준 이미지(assets/mascot/slime-base.jpg)를 참고 이미지로 넣어 FLUX.2 [klein] 4B(Cloudflare Workers AI)로 만든 AI 그림. 배경음악은 agent/music_gen.py가 코드로 만든 음악. 영어 용어 읽기 목소리는 Kokoro-82M(Apache-2.0, hexgrad/Kokoro-82M) af_heart로 이 컴퓨터에서 만든 음성(agent/tts.py)

scene.prompt: Place the same slime character at night in a narrow alley in Seoul, sitting on the stone step in front of a small cozy cafe, warm light glowing from the cafe window, small hanging shop signs without readable letters, wet pavement reflecting the lights. Eye-level medium shot, the slime in the center. Photorealistic 3D render, vertical 4:5, no text, no letters.

items.name: 익스트림 클로즈업
items.desc: 눈이나 입처럼 아주 작은 부분만 가득 담는 화면입니다.
items.prompt: Same slime character, same Seoul alley cafe at night, same lighting and mood as the reference image. Change ONLY the camera: extreme close-up shot, only the slime's face and eyes fill the frame. Photorealistic 3D render, vertical 4:5, no text, no letters.

items.name: 클로즈업
items.prompt: Same slime character, same Seoul alley cafe at night, same lighting and mood as the reference image. Change ONLY the camera: close-up shot, the slime's head and upper body fill the frame. Photorealistic 3D render, vertical 4:5, no text, no letters.

items.name: 미디엄 샷
items.prompt: Same slime character, same Seoul alley cafe at night, same lighting and mood as the reference image. Change ONLY the camera: medium shot, the whole slime and a little of the cafe entrance around it. Photorealistic 3D render, vertical 4:5, no text, no letters.

items.name: 와이드 샷
items.desc: 인물과 주변 장소를 넓게 담는 화면입니다.
items.prompt: Same slime character, same Seoul alley cafe at night, same lighting and mood as the reference image. Change ONLY the camera: wide shot, the whole narrow alley and the cafe front visible, the slime small in the frame. Photorealistic 3D render, vertical 4:5, no text, no letters.

items.name: 로우 앵글
items.prompt: Completely change the camera position and lens; do not keep the reference framing, the reference is only for the slime's look and the place. New camera: extreme low angle. The camera lies on the wet pavement right in front of the slime and points steeply upward. The slime towers over the viewer and looks huge and heroic, its bottom very close and large, its head far above. Above and behind it the cafe signs, the building edges and the dark night sky fill the top half of the frame. Strong upward perspective, building lines converging toward the sky. Keep the same slime character shape and color, same narrow Seoul alley with the small cafe at night, warm cafe light, wet pavement. Photorealistic 3D render, vertical 4:5, no text, no letters.

items.name: 하이 앵글
items.prompt: Completely change the camera position and lens; do not keep the reference framing, the reference is only for the slime's look and the place. New camera: high angle. The camera is high up, about two floors above the alley, pointing down at about 45 degrees. The slime looks small and alone on the step, seen from above, the top of its head and ears visible. Much of the frame is the wet pavement around it. The cafe window and signs are only at the top edge, seen from above. Keep the same slime character shape and color, same narrow Seoul alley with the small cafe at night, warm cafe light, wet pavement. Photorealistic 3D render, vertical 4:5, no text, no letters.

items.name: 버즈아이 뷰
items.prompt: Completely change the camera position and lens; do not keep the reference framing, the reference is only for the slime's look and the place. New camera: bird's-eye view, the camera directly overhead pointing straight down, perfectly vertical top-down view. The slime is seen from the very top: only the top of its round head and two ears, small in the middle of the frame. The frame is filled with the pattern of wet paving stones of the alley, the edge of the cafe step and the warm light spilling from the door onto the ground. No walls or sky visible, flat map-like view. Keep the same slime character shape and color, same narrow Seoul alley with the small cafe at night, warm cafe light, wet pavement. Photorealistic 3D render, vertical 4:5, no text, no letters.

items.name: 더치 앵글
items.prompt: Completely change the camera position and lens; do not keep the reference framing, the reference is only for the slime's look and the place. New camera: Dutch angle. The whole image is rotated 25 degrees clockwise: the horizon, the cafe door frame, the building edges and the slime are all strongly tilted diagonally across the frame. No vertical line in the image is upright. Tense, uneasy mood. Keep the same slime character shape and color, same narrow Seoul alley with the small cafe at night, warm cafe light, wet pavement. Photorealistic 3D render, vertical 4:5, no text, no letters.

items.name: 오버 더 숄더
items.desc: 한 인물의 어깨 너머로 다른 대상을 보는 화면입니다.
items.prompt: Completely change the camera position and lens; do not keep the reference framing, the reference is only for the slime's look and the place. New camera: over-the-shoulder shot. A large dark out-of-focus shoulder and the back of the head of a person in a dark coat fill the left third and the bottom of the frame in the foreground, very close to the camera. Past that shoulder, the slime faces the camera in sharp focus on the cafe step, looking at the person, as if in a conversation. Keep the same slime character shape and color, same narrow Seoul alley with the small cafe at night, warm cafe light, wet pavement. Photorealistic 3D render, vertical 4:5, no text, no letters.

items.name: 얕은 심도(보케)
items.desc: 초점이 맞은 곳만 선명하고 배경은 흐린 화면입니다.
items.prompt: Completely change the camera position and lens; do not keep the reference framing, the reference is only for the slime's look and the place. New camera: 85mm lens at f/1.2, extremely shallow depth of field. The camera is close to the slime at its eye level. Only the slime is razor sharp. Everything behind it is completely melted into a smooth blur: the cafe, the signs and the alley become large soft round bokeh circles of warm orange and white light filling the background. No background details readable at all, the wet ground in front is also blurred. Keep the same slime character shape and color, same narrow Seoul alley with the small cafe at night, warm cafe light, wet pavement. Photorealistic 3D render, vertical 4:5, no text, no letters.

items.name: 아나모픽 렌즈 플레어
items.desc: 아나모픽 렌즈에서 생기는 가로로 긴 빛 번짐입니다.
items.prompt: Same slime character, same Seoul alley cafe at night, same lighting and mood as the reference image. Change ONLY the camera: shot with an anamorphic lens, long horizontal blue lens flares across the frame from the cafe lights, cinematic look. Photorealistic 3D render, vertical 4:5, no text, no letters.

items.name: 35mm 필름 질감
items.prompt: Completely change the camera position and lens; do not keep the reference framing, the reference is only for the slime's look and the place. New camera: shot on 35mm Kodak Portra 400 film with an old film camera, slightly off-center framing from a little to the side. Heavy visible film grain all over the image, faded warm film colors, slightly lifted blacks, soft halation glow around the lights, a light leak of orange on one edge, a little softness like a real 1990s analog photo, not a clean digital render. Keep the same slime character shape and color, same narrow Seoul alley with the small cafe at night, warm cafe light, wet pavement. Photorealistic 3D render, vertical 4:5, no text, no letters.

items.name: 어안 렌즈
items.desc: 화면 가장자리가 둥글게 휘는 초광각 렌즈입니다.
items.prompt: Completely change the camera position and lens; do not keep the reference framing, the reference is only for the slime's look and the place. New camera: 8mm circular fisheye lens held very close to the slime, almost touching it. Extreme barrel distortion: the slime's face bulges big and round in the center, the alley walls, the cafe front and the signs bend into strong curves around the edges of a round image, the street lines curve like a bubble. Black corners outside the circular fisheye image. Keep the same slime character shape and color, same narrow Seoul alley with the small cafe at night, warm cafe light, wet pavement. Photorealistic 3D render, vertical 4:5, no text, no letters.

items.name: 틸트시프트
items.desc: 초점 띠를 좁혀 실제 풍경을 미니어처처럼 보이게 하는 기법입니다.
items.prompt: Completely change the camera position and lens; do not keep the reference framing, the reference is only for the slime's look and the place. New camera: tilt-shift miniature photo. The camera is high up and far away, looking down diagonally at the whole alley from a rooftop. The alley, the cafe, the doors and the tiny slime on the step look like a toy miniature model. Only a thin horizontal band in the middle where the slime sits is sharp. The top third and the bottom third of the image are heavily blurred. Saturated colors, toy-like look. Keep the same slime character shape and color, same narrow Seoul alley with the small cafe at night, warm cafe light, wet pavement. Photorealistic 3D render, vertical 4:5, no text, no letters.

items.name: 실루엣
items.desc: 밝은 배경 앞에서 대상이 검은 윤곽으로만 보이는 화면입니다.
items.prompt: Completely change the camera position and lens; do not keep the reference framing, the reference is only for the slime's look and the place. New camera and light: silhouette. The camera is low and the slime sits directly in front of the brightly lit cafe window, which fills most of the frame behind it and glows very bright, almost white. The slime is completely backlit and appears as a pure black silhouette: only its outline with the two cat ears is visible, no green color, no face, no details on the slime. The rest of the alley is dark. Keep the same slime character shape and color, same narrow Seoul alley with the small cafe at night, warm cafe light, wet pavement. Photorealistic 3D render, vertical 4:5, no text, no letters.

caption:
AI 영상 프롬프트 카메라 앵글·샷 용어 15가지, 장면 끝에 하나만 넣어도 영화처럼 달라집니다.
댓글 남기시면 카메라 용어 전체 30개를 DM으로 보내 드려요.

밤의 서울 골목 카페 앞에 같은 슬라임을 두고 카메라 용어만 바꿔 15장을 뽑았습니다.
로우 앵글은 주인공을 크고 당당하게, 하이 앵글은 작아 보이게 합니다.
더치 앵글은 화면을 비스듬히 기울여 불안한 느낌을 줘요.
얕은 심도는 배경을 흐리게 날리고 주인공만 또렷하게 남깁니다.

AI로 쇼츠 영상을 만드는 친구에게 보내 주세요.

팔로우하고 댓글 남기시면 카메라 용어 30개의 뜻과 쓰는 법을 DM으로 보내 드려요.

dm.message:
요청하신 카메라 용어 30개, 뜻과 쓰는 법까지 정리해 뒀어요.
아래 '자료 보기'를 누르면 용어마다 뜻과 화면 느낌을 예시 그림과 함께 볼 수 있어요.
장면 설명 끝에 카메라 용어 하나만 붙여 보세요. 같은 장면도 영화처럼 달라져요.
dm.cta:
팔로우하고 댓글 남기시면
카메라 용어 30개를
보내 드립니다

page.intro: AI 영상과 그림에 쓰는 카메라 용어 30개를 정리했어요. 촬영 현장에서 쓰는 이름이라 AI도 그대로 알아들어요. 카메라 움직임처럼 영상에서만 보이는 용어도 함께 담았어요.
page.list_intro: 번호는 영상에 나온 순서와 같아요. 그림은 토큰전쟁 마스코트 슬라임으로 만든 예시예요.

page.more_intro: 영상에 나오지 않은 용어 15개예요. 일부 용어에는 예시 그림을 붙였어요.

threads.text:
AI 영상이 어설퍼 보이는 이유는 카메라 이야기가 프롬프트에 빠져서인 경우가 많습니다.

로우 앵글을 넣으면 주인공이 크고 당당해 보이고, 더치 앵글을 넣으면 화면이 기울어 긴장감이 생기거든요.
클로즈업, 와이드 샷, 얕은 심도처럼 촬영 현장에서 쓰는 말을 그대로 넣으면 됩니다.

장면 설명을 길게 늘리기 전에 카메라 위치부터 한 단어 넣어 보세요.
